info.title: QAgent API
info.description: Backend API for QAgent autonomous web application QA platform

get.description: Postgres is pinged for real; Jev, Bedrock and object storage report whether they are configured.
Returns static array of all fixture events for testing.

Streams recorded QA run events over SSE.
Frontend Coder 2 connects to this to design real-time charts, telemetry, and step cards.

parameters.name: loop

schema.description: Whether to loop the events indefinitely
schema.title: Loop

parameters.description: Whether to loop the events indefinitely

get.description: Everything the home dashboard shows, across all apps, for the last `days` days.

post.description: Claude tidies dictated or rough text for a purpose (tidy, description, prd, notes). Nothing is saved.

get.description: Apps with last-run summary, pass rate over the last 20 runs, and open issue count.

delete.description: Deletes the app with its test plans, runs, bugs, reports and stored screenshots/files. Cannot be undone.

post.description:
Claude turns the app's product document (or `prd` from the request) into a high-level test plan of goal-driven
journeys. Nothing is saved; the author reviews and saves it like any other plan.

get.description: Saved sign-in details by name. Secret values are never returned.

schema.title: Response List Credentials Apps  App Id  Credentials Get

put.description: Saves (or replaces) one sign-in detail, encrypted. Tests type it in by field name ("Enter the password").

get.description: Test files the app's upload steps can use, plus the built-in samples every app has.

schema.title: Response List App Files Apps  App Id  Files Get

post.description: Stores a test file. Send the raw file as the request body and its name as `?name=`. Same name replaces.

get.description: The app's clean-up policy and how many runs it would remove right now.

post.description: Applies the app's policy now. Does nothing when the app keeps runs for ever.

schema.title: Response List App Runs Apps  App Id  Runs Get

post.description: Starts a run for an app: {playbook_id?, flow_keys?, include_edge_cases, mode}.
Claude proposes REQ- items from the app's PRD; each must be accepted by the user before it is saved.
Re-runs a finished run deterministically from its decision tape; `overrides` tweak gating and budgets.

delete.description: Deletes one run with its steps, findings, evidence, reports and stored files. Bugs it was the only proof of go too.

get.description: SSE stream of run events. Resumes from `after` or the standard Last-Event-ID header.

schema.title: Response Run Flows Runs  Run Id  Flows Get
Response Run Findings Runs  Run Id  Findings Get
Response Run Network Runs  Run Id  Network Get
Response Run Spans Runs  Run Id  Spans Get
Response Run Logs Runs  Run Id  Logs Get

get.description: Flat list of steps (with timings, decision and findings) across the run's flows.

schema.title: Response Run Steps Runs  Run Id  Steps Get

get.description: Every check result with its bound inputs and where each came from.

schema.title: Response Run Checks Runs  Run Id  Checks Get

get.description: Artifacts of a run (optionally one step): id, kind, key and a stable URL, e.g. to list a step's wait frames.
Every model call of the run in the order it happened: plans, step decisions, judgements, report calls.

schema.title: Response Run Tape Runs  Run Id  Tape Get
Response List App Playbooks Apps  App Id  Playbooks Get

post.description: Parses, validates and stores a Markdown playbook; unchanged content does not create a new version.
Parses and validates Markdown without saving it (drives the editor's inline errors and coverage panel).
Confirms edited Markdown as a new version of an existing playbook (same content creates nothing).

schema.title: Response List Versions Playbooks  Playbook Id  Versions Get

post.description: Claude rewrites a freeform test description into canonical playbook Markdown (nothing is saved).

delete.description:
Deletes a test plan with its items and links. Its past runs are kept (with the plan's content, so they can still be
repeated) unless `delete_runs=true`, which removes them too, with their screenshots, proof and reports.

schema.title: Response List Items Playbook Versions  Version Id  Items Get

get.description: The evidence graph for one finding: screenshots, network calls, decisions, spans, trace, check inputs.
Current flows and edge-case variants with their last 10 results, median duration and flakiness.

schema.title: Response App Flows Apps  App Id  Flows Get
Response List Issues Apps  App Id  Issues Get

get.description: The latest bug report for the issue.

post.description: Rebuilds the run report and its bug reports from stored facts (narrative is regenerated too).

get.description: Markdown or HTML as stored; PDF is the HTML printed by Playwright (generated on first request).

Requirements -> the flows, formulas, UX rules and edge cases that cover them -> their latest check results
-> findings -> issues. Built from the stored item links and the most recent run of the version.
Serves e.g. steps/3/screenshot.jpg, steps/3/dom.html, network/{call}/response.json, trace.zip.
Shorthand for the first flow's screenshot; use the flow-qualified route when flows run in parallel.
A short-lived presigned URL (images, trace.zip, PDF); with local storage, the proxied content URL.
Proxied bytes (JSON, HTML, text): browsers cannot fetch() presigned URLs without bucket CORS rules.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Derived from the URL's hostname when omitted

name.title: Name
name.description: Derived from the URL's hostname when omitted

reset_path.title: Reset Path
reset_path.description: POST here before each run to reset the app

allowed_hosts.title: Allowed Hosts
allowed_hosts.description: Defaults to the base URL's hostname

app_id.title: App Id
app_id.description: Ignored on app-scoped and version routes

include_edge_cases.title: Include Edge Cases
include_edge_cases.description: Also run edge-case variants of the selected flows

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: Let Claude write a short note for each step before a journey runs

value.title: Value
value.description: Only for details that are not secret (a username); null for secrets

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: act | done (step already satisfied) | stuck (no candidate fits)

risky.title: Risky
risky.description: P(action is harmful beyond the test step)

flakiness.title: Flakiness
flakiness.description: Share of consecutive runs whose status changed

created.title: Created
created.description: False when the content hash matched the latest version

items.title: Items
items.description: Every parsed item: key, category, title, body

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: The proposals as playbook Markdown, ready to paste under ## Requirements

prd.title: Prd
prd.description: Use this text instead of the app's saved product document

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: Default: hidden unless the name looks like a username

TapeEntry.title: TapeEntry
TapeEntry.description: One model call on a run's tape: a step decision, a judgement, a plan, or a report call.
